senses.definition: to take a child or an animal into your home and make it part of your family

examples.text: We adopted a cat from the animal shelter.
The couple adopted a baby girl last year.
examples.translation: Cütlük keçən il bir qız uşağını övladlığa götürdü.

senses.definition: (about a pet animal) lost or without a home

examples.text: There are many stray cats on our street.
She gives food to stray dogs every evening.
examples.translation: O, hər axşam sahibsiz itlərə yemək verir.

examples.text: We took our dog to the vet because he was sick.
examples.translation: İtimiz xəstə olduğu üçün onu baytara apardıq.

examples.text: The vet gave the cat some medicine.

senses.definition: a person who has something, for example a pet, a house or a business

examples.text: The dog waited at the door for its owner.
The owner of the café is my cousin.

senses.definition: the thick, soft hair that covers the body of some animals

homonyms.meaning: a tall tree with thin, sharp leaves that stay green all year

examples.text: Our cat has soft white fur.
The dog's fur was wet after the rain.

senses.definition: the long part at the back of an animal's body

homonyms.meaning: a story, often about imaginary events

examples.text: The dog was wagging its tail happily.
Some monkeys use their tails to hold branches.
examples.translation: Bəzi meymunlar budaqlardan tutmaq üçün quyruqlarından istifadə edir.

senses.definition: (about a dog) to make a short, loud sound

homonyms.meaning: (noun) the hard outer covering of a tree

examples.text: The neighbor's dog barks all night.
Our dog always barks at the mailman.

senses.definition: to rub or mark something with your nails or with something sharp

examples.text: The cat scratched my hand when I tried to pick it up.
examples.translation: Pişiyi qucağıma götürmək istəyəndə əlimi cırmaqladı.

examples.text: Try not to scratch your mosquito bites.

senses.definition: to do what a person, a rule or a law tells you to do

examples.text: The dog has learned to obey simple commands.
examples.translation: İt sadə əmrlərə tabe olmağı öyrənib.

examples.text: Drivers must obey the traffic rules.
examples.translation: Sürücülər yol hərəkəti qaydalarına əməl etməlidirlər.

senses.definition: a box made of metal bars or wire, where animals or birds are kept

examples.text: My grandmother keeps two birds in a cage.
The lions walked around their cage.
examples.translation: Şirlər qəfəslərinin içində o tərəf-bu tərəfə gəzirdilər.

senses.definition: to break food or something else into small pieces with your teeth

examples.text: Chew your food well before you swallow it.
The puppy chewed my new slippers.
What an adorable baby!
The kittens were so adorable that everyone wanted one.
examples.translation: Pişik balaları o qədər şirin idi ki, hamı birini istəyirdi.

senses.definition: a duty to take care of someone or something, or to do a job

examples.text: Looking after a baby is a big responsibility.
It's my responsibility to lock the office at night.

senses.definition: to look after someone or something and keep them safe and well

examples.text: Who will take care of your plants while you're away?
She is taking care of her sick grandmother.

senses.definition: kind and calm, and careful not to hurt anyone

examples.text: Be gentle with the baby.
examples.translation: Körpəyə qarşı yumşaq və ehtiyatlı ol.

examples.text: Our dog is big but very gentle with children.
examples.translation: İtimiz böyükdür, amma uşaqlarla çox mülayimdir.

story.title: The Dog at the Bus Stop

sentences.text: For weeks, a small stray dog lived at the bus stop near Kamran's office.
sentences.translation: Həftələrlə kiçik bir sahibsiz it Kamranın ofisinin yaxınlığındakı avtobus dayanacağında yaşayırdı.

sentences.text: She had dirty brown fur, a short tail and the saddest eyes Kamran had ever seen.
sentences.translation: Onun çirkli qəhvəyi tükləri, qısa quyruğu və Kamranın indiyə qədər gördüyü ən qəmgin gözləri var idi.

sentences.text: Every morning he shared his breakfast with her, although he knew it wasn't enough.
sentences.translation: Hər səhər o, səhər yeməyini onunla bölüşürdü, baxmayaraq ki, bunun kifayət etmədiyini bilirdi.

sentences.text: He wanted to adopt her.
sentences.translation: O, iti evə götürmək istəyirdi.

sentences.text: However, he lived in a small apartment, and he had never had a pet.
sentences.translation: Lakin o, kiçik bir mənzildə yaşayırdı və heç vaxt ev heyvanı saxlamamışdı.

sentences.text: One rainy evening, he found her shivering under a bench.
sentences.translation: Yağışlı bir axşam o, iti skamyanın altında titrəyən halda tapdı.

sentences.text: This time he didn't hesitate.
sentences.translation: Bu dəfə o, tərəddüd etmədi.

sentences.text: He took her home and named her Findiq, because her fur was the color of hazelnuts.
sentences.translation: Onu evə apardı və adını Fındıq qoydu, çünki tükləri fındıq rəngində idi.

sentences.text: The next day, he took her to the vet, who said she was about two years old and healthy.
sentences.translation: Ertəsi gün onu baytara apardı, baytar isə itin təxminən iki yaşında və sağlam olduğunu dedi.

sentences.text: The vet also gave him a small cage for car trips.
sentences.translation: Baytar ona maşın səfərləri üçün kiçik bir qəfəs də verdi.

sentences.text: The first week was not easy.
sentences.translation: İlk həftə asan olmadı.

sentences.text: Findiq chewed his shoes, scratched the door and barked at every noise in the hallway.
sentences.translation: Fındıq onun ayaqqabılarını gəmirdi, qapını cırmaqlayırdı və dəhlizdəki hər səsə hürürdü.

sentences.text: His neighbor complained, and Kamran started to wonder if he was a good owner.
sentences.translation: Qonşusu şikayət etdi və Kamran yaxşı sahib olub-olmadığı barədə düşünməyə başladı.

sentences.text: Even though he was tired after work, he walked her twice a day and taught her to obey simple commands like “sit” and “stay.”
sentences.translation: İşdən sonra yorğun olsa da, onu gündə iki dəfə gəzdirir və ona “otur”, “gözlə” kimi sadə əmrlərə tabe olmağı öyrədirdi.

sentences.text: Slowly, Findiq changed.
sentences.translation: Yavaş-yavaş Fındıq dəyişdi.

sentences.text: She became calm and gentle, and she stopped barking at night.
sentences.translation: O, sakit və mülayim oldu, gecələr hürməyi də dayandırdı.

sentences.text: Even the neighbor, who had complained before, now thinks she is adorable.
sentences.translation: Hətta əvvəllər şikayət edən qonşu da indi onu çox şirin hesab edir.

sentences.text: Having a dog is a big responsibility, and Kamran's life is busier than before.
sentences.translation: İt saxlamaq böyük məsuliyyətdir və Kamranın həyatı əvvəlkindən daha məşğuldur.

sentences.text: However, when he comes home and Findiq runs to the door, wagging her tail, he knows it was the right choice.
sentences.translation: Lakin evə gələndə Fındıq quyruğunu bulaya-bulaya qapıya qaçır və Kamran bunun düzgün seçim olduğunu bilir.

sentences.text: “You take care of me too,” he often tells her with a smile.
sentences.translation: “Sən də mənim qayğıma qalırsan,” – deyə o, tez-tez gülümsəyərək itə deyir.

grammar.topic: Linking words for contrast: although, even though, however
grammar.topicTranslation: Ziddiyyət bildirən bağlayıcı sözlər: although, even though, however
grammar.explanation: We use although, even though and however to show a contrast between two ideas. Although and even though join two parts of one sentence: Although it was late, we went out. Even though is a little stronger than although. However usually starts a new sentence and has a comma after it: It was late. However, we went out.
grammar.explanationTranslation: Although, even though və however iki fikir arasındakı ziddiyyəti göstərmək üçün işlədilir. Although və even though bir cümlənin iki hissəsini birləşdirir: Although it was late, we went out. Even though although-dan bir az daha güclü məna verir. However adətən yeni cümləni başlayır və ondan sonra vergül qoyulur: It was late. However, we went out.

rules.text: although / even though + subject + verb: Although he was tired, he walked the dog.
rules.translation: although / even though + mübtəda + feil: Although he was tired, he walked the dog.

rules.text: The although-part can come first or second. If it comes first, put a comma after it: Even though it rained, we went out. / We went out even though it rained.
rules.translation: Although hissəsi cümlənin əvvəlində və ya sonunda gələ bilər. Əvvəldə gələndə ondan sonra vergül qoyulur: Even though it rained, we went out. / We went out even though it rained.

rules.text: However starts a new sentence and needs a comma after it: The flat is small. However, it is cheap.
rules.translation: However yeni cümləni başlayır və ondan sonra vergül qoyulur: The flat is small. However, it is cheap.

rules.text: Don't use but together with although: say Although it was cold, we swam, not Although it was cold, but we swam.
rules.translation: Although ilə birlikdə but işlədilmir: Although it was cold, but we swam yox, Although it was cold, we swam deyilir.

examples.text: Although the dog was dirty, she was very friendly.
examples.translation: İt çirkli olsa da, çox mehriban idi.

examples.text: Even though I'm allergic to cats, I love them.
examples.translation: Pişiklərə allergiyam olsa da, onları çox sevirəm.

examples.text: A pet is fun. However, it is also a big responsibility.
examples.translation: Ev heyvanı əyləncəlidir. Lakin bu, həm də böyük məsuliyyətdir.

examples.text: We wanted a big dog. However, our apartment was too small.
examples.translation: Biz böyük it istəyirdik. Lakin mənzilimiz çox kiçik idi.

examples.text: She obeyed the rules even though she didn't like them.
examples.translation: Qaydaları bəyənməsə də, onlara əməl edirdi.

exercise.instructions: Choose or write the correct linking word.
exercise.instructionsTranslation: Düzgün bağlayıcı sözü seçin və ya yazın.

questions.prompt: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: Although joins two parts of one sentence.
questions.explanationTranslation: Although bir cümlənin iki hissəsini birləşdirir.

questions.prompt: The hotel was expensive. ___, the rooms were small.
questions.promptTranslation: Otel baha idi. Lakin otaqlar kiçik idi.
questions.explanation: However starts a new sentence and has a comma after it.
questions.explanationTranslation: However yeni cümləni başlayır və ondan sonra vergül qoyulur.

questions.prompt: Even though he studied hard, he ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: Even though shows an unexpected result, so the second part is the opposite of what we expect.
questions.explanationTranslation: Even though gözlənilməz nəticəni göstərir, ona görə ikinci hissə gözlədiyimizin əksidir.

questions.prompt: I like my job. ___ (contrast word, new sentence), the salary is low.
questions.explanation: However starts a new sentence that shows a contrast.
questions.explanationTranslation: However ziddiyyət bildirən yeni cümləni başlayır.

questions.prompt: She went to work ___ (two words) she felt ill.
questions.promptTranslation: Özünü pis hiss etsə də, işə getdi.
questions.explanation: Even though joins two contrasting parts of one sentence.
questions.explanationTranslation: Even though bir cümlənin bir-birinə zidd iki hissəsini birləşdirir.
